summary: Publish durable owner audits for idle-residency wake and manual-precedence gates

replay.detail: Owner audit processing records accepted wake messages, automatic resume boundaries and explicitly covered intervals; gaps remain unknown.

schema.detail: Add replicated durable system-only residency.wake-audit, residency.resume-audit and residency.audit-coverage claims.

rules.detail: Lost-wake certification joins wake audits to successful resume completions inside covered windows. Manual suspension cause at either automatic resume boundary is directly visible as a precedence violation.

compatibility.detail: Readers must recognize the new replicated claim kinds before owner audit production is enabled through fleet feature admission.

manual.detail: Existing idle-residency policy configuration is unchanged; missing audit coverage never certifies a zero-violation window.

recovery.detail: Retain audit-capable readers and roll forward; the existing residency rollback contract does not promise downgrade after new replicated kinds are published. Turning policy off stops new sleeps without cancelling queued wakes.
